module_role: Exact project, title-block, sheet, date, scale and complete visual-review ledger for the supplied nine-sheet set.
scope: This is complete ground truth for the nine supplied pages only. It does not claim that the set contains all project disciplines or an unstated revision history.

project.name: Orange County Regional History Center
project.document_date_context: Date Issued in repeated title blocks

revision_date.note: The blank issue-log rows are not recast as revision events.

scale_semantics.finding: All nine supplied pages were visually reviewed. The three roof-plan sheets print 1/8" = 1'-0". M-201 and M-401 print NO SCALE, and M-301/S-500 are detail sheets with N.T.S. captions rather than a measurable plan scale. No supplied page has a graphic scale bar.

visual_review_pages.title: COVER SHEET AND SHEET INDEX
visual_review_pages.finding: Cover/index for the nine supplied sheets; project identity and title-block issue data. No schedule or controls point list.

visual_review_pages.title: HVAC SYMBOLS LEGEND AND GENERAL NOTES
visual_review_pages.finding: HVAC symbols, legends and general notes. The page itself warns that some legend symbols may not pertain to the project; legends are not treated as installed inventory.

visual_review_pages.title: HVAC DEMOLITION ROOF PLAN
visual_review_pages.finding: 1/8" = 1'-0" demolition roof plan: existing cooling tower, chiller, pumps and roof AHU removal/replacement context.

visual_review_pages.title: HVAC NEW WORK ROOF PLAN
visual_review_pages.finding: 1/8" = 1'-0" new-work roof plan: AHU-04 through AHU-08, CH-2, CT-1, and circulation-pump context.

visual_review_pages.title: HVAC PHASING PLAN
visual_review_pages.finding: 1/8" = 1'-0" phasing plan with temporary air-cooled chiller/pump requirements and a temperature/humidity guideline table.

visual_review_pages.title: HVAC CONTROLS
visual_review_pages.finding: No-scale controls schematics for variable-volume AHU-4/5/8, constant-volume AHU-6, and 100% dedicated-outdoor-air AHU-7. Typed point bubbles appear on diagrams; no formal points matrix or written standalone sequence is printed.

visual_review_pages.title: HVAC DETAILS
visual_review_pages.finding: No-scale HVAC details including existing three-way-valve/piping, cooling-tower, chiller and rooftop-AHU details. These are details, not a valve/actuator schedule.

visual_review_pages.title: HVAC SCHEDULES
visual_review_pages.finding: No-scale schedule sheet: five AHUs, one air-cooled chiller, one cooling tower and four electric humidifiers, all transcribed as exact source cells.

visual_review_pages.title: STRUCTURAL SUPPORT DETAILS
visual_review_pages.finding: Structural support details for new mechanical-unit and cooling-tower support; no BAS point list or equipment schedule.
